messages:
Ivy (Finance): AP flagged vendor NebulaGrid invoice NG-0426-77 for PO mismatch and a surprise line item 'resilience surcharge' we don't recognize. Can AP confirm why it's on hold? :thinking:

Liam (AP): billing-bot hold reason = PO_NOT_FOUND + UNAPPROVED_CHARGE. Invoice references PO 6333 but our ledger shows NebulaGrid under PO 6334 for the same period. Also surcharge line $300 not in SOW. Need vendor to reissue or provide signed amendment.

Zoey (Vendor Ops): Reached out to NebulaGrid. They say invoice tool auto-attached surcharge after a brief outage recovery window and grouped invoices under a different PO (6333) due to internal consolidation. They uploaded an "administrative note" (not signed).

Priyanka (Procurement): We can't accept unsigned admin notes. If they consolidated POs they need Procurement approval + signed consolidation memo. For the surcharge, we need contract language that permits such charge; absent that, we won't pay.

billing-bot: Invoice NG-0426-77 uploaded by Zoey; status=HOLD (PO_MISMATCH, UNAPPROVED_CHARGE). Ticket AP-8291.

Ivy (Finance): Two practical paths: 1) Vendor reissue invoice under PO 6334 without surcharge and match quantities; OR 2) vendor provides signed consolidation + a signed amendment that explicitly allows the resilience surcharge with calculation details.

Zoey (Vendor Ops): NebulaGrid replied: they can reissue under PO 6334 and remove the surcharge for this invoice, pending a separate review for fees tied to outage SLAs. They asked if we can consider a one-time goodwill charge instead of a formal amendment.

Liam (AP): We won't accept goodwill charges without written approval. If they reissue clean invoice we can process undisputed portion immediately. For any fee we need Procurement + Finance sign-off and a signed doc.

Priyanka (Procurement): If vendor wants to pursue fees related to outage SLA, they should open a formal claim and provide incident report + calculation. Procurement will evaluate but no payment until approved. Also added vendor restriction: require prior approval for any billing outside SOW.

Zoey (Vendor Ops): Vendor will reissue NG-0426-77v2 today excluding the surcharge and referencing PO 6334. They'll open a separate claim and attach incident report.

billing-bot: New invoice NG-0426-77v2 uploaded by Zoey; matched to PO 6334 and pending AP validation.

Liam (AP): Verified PO match and amounts. Routing for payment. Closing hold. :white_check_mark:

Ivy (Finance): Thanks. Priyanka please confirm whether Procurement wants claim materials for review; I'll keep ticket AP-8291 updated.

Priyanka (Procurement): Yes, ask them to include incident timeline, affected usage hrs, and formula for surcharge. We'll review once submitted.
